steps: The native helper calls ProjectLibrary(name: name, scene: .portrait(), id: id).
The presentation retains original.name, which no longer includes the fixture's leading/trailing U+0020.
The final assertion compares Array(row.project.name.unicodeScalars) against Array(name.unicodeScalars), whose leading/trailing U+0020 remain.
reproduction.predicted_actual: Stored scalar array is [0x200D, 0x2800, 0xFE0F]; expected array is [0x20, 0x200D, 0x2800, 0xFE0F, 0x20]. The assertion disagrees despite correct presentation preservation.

findings.impact: The newly expanded required native method cannot meet this expectation as written; it would report a regression unrelated to the intended display-content fix.
findings.recommendation: Compare row.project.name scalars against original.name scalars to test preservation across presentation. If checking normalization too, assert original.name against the explicitly normalized expectation separately. Alternatively remove outer spaces from this native fixture while retaining the whitespace case in the core newInput/display test.
